t_advice_summary_textbox.text: four coloured gnomes open an orange basket and the other four colours open the other basket. Stick to one set until the value of the mushrooms goes down, then change to the other set of colours

vb_textbox.text: Red, purple, pink and brown gnomes belong to the red basket. Blue, yellow, green and orange gnomes belong to the yellow basket. Stick with the same set of colours until the value of mushrooms goes down, then try the other basket. Remember to be quick and also to press spacebar to add the mushrooms!
